# Projects

A synthetic corpus file for the duplicate-rate measurement; none of this text is memory content. The
claims below carry no metadata span, so the markdown formatter cannot reshape the claim text they
are measured on. All eight describe unrelated everyday subjects on purpose: no pair of them shares
enough normalized tokens to reach the duplicate boundary, so this file is the clean volume that
keeps the corpus rate low while the boundary files stay deliberate.

- [c-2026-0301] The bakery on Miller Street bakes rye loaves before the morning rush.

- [c-2026-0302] A violet umbrella dries slowly beside the office radiator.

- [c-2026-0303] The chess club meets above the bookshop every second Thursday.

- [c-2026-0304] The kettle whistles twice before pouring green tea for guests.

- [c-2026-0305] Stargazers gather on the reservoir dam when the forecast stays clear.

- [c-2026-0306] The freight train waits at platform nine until just past noon.

- [c-2026-0307] The puppet workshop borrows fabric scraps from the costume attic.

- [c-2026-0308] Volunteers repaint the harbor railings each October, weather permitting.
